name: Sawamura Yuri
source:
Head of the drama club. She is Nano’s sister. She has a straightforward personality and is popular with both boys and girls. 

She’s a great cook, but she’s not good at complicated things (or rather, she can’t even think about them). During arguments over the protagonist, she often gets talked into things by Nano.

While she excels at playing the love rival, in real life she lacks courage. Even when she immerses herself  in seducing the protagonist, she tries to hide her shyness. it’s no surprise she’s still a virgin.

[From [url=http://www.sp-janis.com/speed/tabegoro/]official site[/url]]
